title: Sharded mutation matrices lose no coverage
note: Every spec in exactly one deterministic shard; the workflow matrix generated and checked; the aggregate green only when every shard's result is success; each shard fails on any non-zero matrix exit, runs every spec regardless, and checks the tracked tree with git.

mutations.name: MS1_a_spec_falls_out_of_the_plan
mutations.find: for name in sorted(names, key=lambda s: (-w[s], s)):
mutations.replace: for name in sorted(names, key=lambda s: (-w[s], s))[1:]:
mutations.rationale: THE loss sharding must not cause: the heaviest spec silently runs nowhere

mutations.name: MS2_every_spec_lands_in_one_shard
mutations.rationale: the loads never move, so every spec piles into shard 1 and the time is not saved

mutations.name: MS3_the_matrix_is_not_compared_to_the_plan
mutations.rationale: a spec deleted from the workflow block would stop running with the contract green

mutations.name: MS4_fail_fast_may_come_back
mutations.rationale: one red shard cancels the others and their verdicts are never taken

mutations.name: MS5_the_aggregate_may_be_skipped
mutations.rationale: a skipped aggregate reports nothing instead of red

mutations.name: MS6_the_aggregate_need_not_see_success
mutations.replace: if False and "needs.mutation-shards.result" not in agg or \
mutations.rationale: overall green stops meaning every shard passed

mutations.name: MS8_the_shard_stops_at_the_first_failure
mutations.rationale: one red spec hides every spec after it

mutations.name: MS9_a_changed_tree_passes
mutations.find: return 1 if failed or changed else 0
mutations.rationale: git as the independent check of restoration is dropped

mutations.name: MS10_an_empty_shard_passes
mutations.rationale: a shard given nothing passes having run nothing

mutations.name: MS11_a_stale_shard_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a hand-edited matrix runs whatever it lists

mutations.name: MS12_the_contract_never_asks
mutations.find: out += [f"mutation shards -- {x}" for x in MS.check_workflow(body)]
mutations.rationale: K1: the shard check exists and the verifier CI runs never consults it
